
set(LLAMACPP_INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/deps/install/llamacpp)

if(RETDEC_NEURAL_GPU_OFFLOAD)
	set(_RETDEC_LLAMA_GGML_CUDA ON)
else()
	set(_RETDEC_LLAMA_GGML_CUDA OFF)
endif()

if(LLAMACPP_LOCAL_DIR)
	set(LLAMACPP_SOURCE_DIR "${LLAMACPP_LOCAL_DIR}")
	set(_LLAMACPP_URL "")
else()
	set(LLAMACPP_SOURCE_DIR "")
	set(_LLAMACPP_URL "${LLAMACPP_URL}")
endif()

ExternalProject_Add(llamacpp-project
	SOURCE_DIR ${LLAMACPP_SOURCE_DIR}
	URL ${_LLAMACPP_URL}
	URL_HASH SHA256=${LLAMACPP_ARCHIVE_SHA256}
	DOWNLOAD_NAME llamacpp.zip
	DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE
	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${LLAMACPP_INSTALL_DIR}
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${RETDEC_EP_CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}
		-DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON
		-DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF
		-DLLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
		-DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
		-DLLAMA_CURL=OFF
		-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
		-DGGML_CUDA=${_RETDEC_LLAMA_GGML_CUDA}
	BUILD_BYPRODUCTS
		${LLAMACPP_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}llama${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build <BINARY_DIR> --target install
)

ExternalProject_Get_Property(llamacpp-project BINARY_DIR)
set(LLAMACPP_BINARY_DIR ${BINARY_DIR})

add_library(llama STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
add_dependencies(llama llamacpp-project)
set_target_properties(llama PROPERTIES
	IMPORTED_LOCATION
		${LLAMACPP_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}llama${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}
	INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
		${LLAMACPP_INSTALL_DIR}/include
)

add_library(retdec::deps::llamacpp ALIAS llama)

install(
	FILES
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/retdec-llamacpp-config.cmake"
	DESTINATION
		"${RETDEC_INSTALL_CMAKE_DIR}"
)
